'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Aaron Kingery LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Echo Base Operations|Hoth-L-echobaseoperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Hello, My Name Is Inigo Montoya
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
